manual_sample_findings: Four representative images show isolated pistachio samples on a black background; no people or brand marks were visible in the reviewed samples. This is not a full manual review.
license_claim: Mendeley Data v1 displays CC BY 4.0. The 2021 related research article has a separate CC BY-NC 4.0 statement; the article and dataset licenses are recorded separately.
dataset_creation_claim: The related 2022 research article states that the authors collected the pistachio samples for the study and created the images using their specially designed computer-vision system in a fixed lighting setup. Dataset contributor Murat Koklu is among the article authors/data curators.

basis: Mendeley Data v1 explicitly displays CC BY 4.0 for the fixed dataset version.
The 2022 paper states that its authors collected the samples and created the images with their own computer-vision system.
Murat Koklu is the Mendeley contributor and is listed among the study authors/data curators.
The related article's license is recorded separately; article PDFs and figures are not distributed.
rights_review.attribution: Murat Koklu, Pistachio Image Dataset, Mendeley Data v1, DOI 10.17632/h7pf57cgg9.1, CC BY 4.0; cite the two requested papers.
limitations: No independent rights-transfer document was reviewed; this decision relies on the contributor's explicit dataset license and authors' image-creation statement.
Only four representative images received manual visual review; this is not a full manual image review.
